messages.text:
ZOPs are live.
ZOPs (Zero Operators) run generative models inside TouchDesigner. Image and video ZOPs output a TOP. Text ZOPs output a DAT.
What's inside:
Text: Claude, GPT, Gemini
Image: Nano Banana, Flux, Seedream
Video: Kling, Seedance, Veo, Wan
Full list updates live in the panel.
Open the ZOPs panel from the TWOZERO tool list, or assign a hotkey in Settings. Browse families, hit Enter to drop a ZOP with the family-default model. Pick a specific variant if you want it pinned. Right-click any row for model metadata and pricing.
Each ZOP behaves like a regular TD operator. The output drops straight into the network, and every TD tool you already use works on it.
Pay-per-use. Estimated price sits next to each model in the panel; the actual charge appears in the status bar after a run completes. Failed generations are not charged. Top up at https://app.twozero.ai/billing.
Docs: https://twozero.ai/docs/zops
Download: https://www.404zero.com/pisang/twozero.tox
Made by 404.zero and setupdesign. Questions in ⁠questions-and-support, bugs in ⁠bug-reports, show your work in ⁠show-your-work.
